user.title: Login information
user.description: Generate an API key, access token, and refresh token at {portal_url} (log in with your existing Electrolux account, create an API key, then generate a token pair).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Electrolux AC
reauth_confirm.description: Your Electrolux credentials are no longer valid. Generate a fresh API key, access token, and refresh token at {portal_url} and enter them below.

error.reauth_account_mismatch: These credentials belong to a different Electrolux account than the one currently configured. Sign in with the original account, or remove this integration and add it again.
